{
  "canonical_current_state": {
    "format": "JSON",
    "path": ".eos/state/current.json",
    "role": "SOLE_OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY",
    "schema": ".eos/schemas/canonical-state.schema.json",
    "writes": "EOS_TRANSACTION_ONLY"
  },
  "commands": {
    "github_sync": "./scripts/eos github-sync --apply",
    "legacy_rebuild_alias": "./scripts/eos rebuild-state [--apply] -> canonical projection",
    "project": "./scripts/eos state project --apply",
    "reconcile_github": "./scripts/eos state reconcile github --target <ID> --strategy canonical-wins",
    "reconcile_local": "./scripts/eos state reconcile local --strategy canonical-wins",
    "status": "./scripts/eos state status"
  },
  "drift_classes": {
    "EVENT_HISTORY_DRIFT": "BLOCK_ALL_ORDINARY_EOS_OPERATIONS",
    "GITHUB_REMOTE_DRIFT": "BLOCK_AUTOMATIC_GITHUB_OVERWRITE",
    "GITHUB_STALE_AFTER_CANONICAL_CHANGE": "EXPLICITLY_REPORTED_AND_MUST_BE_SYNCHRONIZED_BEFORE_SUBSEQUENT_ORDINARY_WORK",
    "LOCAL_PROJECTION_DRIFT": "BLOCK_ALL_ORDINARY_EOS_OPERATIONS"
  },
  "model_id": "EOS-SINGLE-CANONICAL-STATE-1",
  "mutation_history": {
    "canonical_current_state": false,
    "event_ledger": ".eos/events.jsonl",
    "git": "repository history",
    "role": "AUDIT_AND_RECONSTRUCTION_EVIDENCE",
    "rule": "History may prove or challenge canonical state but never silently replaces it."
  },
  "projections": {
    "github": {
      "direction": "CANONICAL_TO_GITHUB",
      "drift": "RECEIPT_AND_REMOTE_FINGERPRINT_REQUIRED",
      "external_edits": "PROPOSALS_OR_DRIFT_NOT_CANONICAL_WRITES",
      "role": "SYNCHRONIZED_COLLABORATION_PROJECTION",
      "write_back": "EXPLICIT_GOVERNED_RECONCILIATION_ONLY"
    },
    "git": {
      "canonical_current_state": false,
      "role": "VERSION_HISTORY_AND_INTEGRITY"
    },
    "markdown": {
      "content": "GOVERNED_HUMAN_CONTENT",
      "direct_lifecycle_write": "FORBIDDEN",
      "drift": "FAIL_CLOSED",
      "lifecycle_metadata": "CANONICAL_TO_PROJECTION",
      "role": "HUMAN_READABLE_GOVERNED_ARTIFACT"
    },
    "tsv": {
      "direct_write": "FORBIDDEN",
      "direction": "CANONICAL_TO_PROJECTION",
      "drift": "FAIL_CLOSED",
      "paths": [
        ".eos/program-increments.tsv",
        ".eos/work-cycles.tsv",
        ".eos/work-packets.tsv",
        ".eos/change-requests.tsv",
        ".eos/maintenance.tsv",
        ".eos/releases.tsv"
      ],
      "role": "GENERATED_COMPATIBILITY_PROJECTION"
    }
  },
  "reconciliation": {
    "default": "NEVER_AUTO_ADOPT_PROJECTION",
    "event_ledger": "APPEND_CORRECTIVE_GOVERNED_EVENTS; NEVER REWRITE HISTORY",
    "github": "CANONICAL_WINS_ONLY_BY_EXPLICIT_RECONCILE; EXTERNAL PROPOSALS MUST ENTER EOS THROUGH A GOVERNED CHANGE",
    "local": "CANONICAL_WINS"
  },
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "status": "NORMATIVE",
  "transaction_protocol": [
    "preflight canonical schema and local projection consistency",
    "verify GitHub remote receipt before an applying GitHub synchronization",
    "record canonical revision and event count in an ephemeral transaction receipt",
    "run the compatibility EOS operation against generated projections",
    "on failure discard transaction receipt and leave canonical state unchanged",
    "on success require TSV, Markdown lifecycle metadata, and event history to agree",
    "capture the successful mutation into canonical current state and increment revision only when operational state changed",
    "regenerate machine projections from canonical state",
    "record projection fingerprints and synchronization receipts",
    "fail or explicitly report any remaining projection drift"
  ]
}
